source_caption:
Definitely a plot twist for the year!

Andrew Scott’s viral therapist cameo takes place in the opening scene of the A24 comedy series It Gets Worse. Created by and starring British comedian Leo Reich, the six-part show follows three university friends stumbling through their twenties in London, the series explores the messiness of friendship, dysfunctional relationships, disappointing careers and the uncomfortable reality of becoming an adult. Critics have praised the show as a sharp, Gen-Z spiritual successor to Girls and Peep Show, earning a 94% score on Rotten Tomatoes.

It Gets Worse is streaming now on Paramount+
